Description: Gather stakeholder needs, business goals, current problems, and the initial scope for the software project.
Comments: Draft guidance: identify decision makers and capture unresolved questions; confirm stakeholder availability before relying on these estimates.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Stakeholder interviews & requirements gathering.
Gather stakeholder needs, business goals, current problems, and the initial scope for the software project.
Review results and record acceptance of Stakeholder interviews & requirements gathering.

Description: Document the agreed requirements, scope boundaries, priorities, and acceptance expectations.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm who approves the requirements and how later scope changes will be handled.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Product requirements document.
Document the agreed requirements, scope boundaries, priorities, and acceptance expectations.
Review results and record acceptance of Product requirements document.

Description: Understand target users and map the main journeys through the product.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm access to representative users; record findings and assumptions that affect the proposed flows.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for UX research & user flows.
Understand target users and map the main journeys through the product.
Review results and record acceptance of UX research & user flows.

Description: Define the technical approach, system components, interfaces, and major design decisions.
Comments: Draft guidance: identify technical unknowns and external constraints; create separate investigation tasks where uncertainty needs resolution.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Technical architecture & design.
Define the technical approach, system components, interfaces, and major design decisions.
Review results and record acceptance of Technical architecture & design.

Description: Create low-detail screen layouts that demonstrate the agreed user flows and interactions.
Comments: Draft guidance: plan review time with product stakeholders; distinguish design effort from any waiting for feedback.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Wireframes.
Create low-detail screen layouts that demonstrate the agreed user flows and interactions.
Review results and record acceptance of Wireframes.

Description: Develop the visual design and reusable interface styles and components for the agreed screens.
Comments: Draft guidance: agree which screens and states are included; confirm review expectations and accessibility needs.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Visual design & UI kit.
Develop the visual design and reusable interface styles and components for the agreed screens.
Review results and record acceptance of Visual design & UI kit.

Description: Set up development tooling and automated build, test, and delivery workflows.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm repository access, credentials, and target environments; track blocked access separately from hands-on setup effort.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Dev environment & CI/CD pipeline.
Set up development tooling and automated build, test, and delivery workflows.
Review results and record acceptance of Dev environment & CI/CD pipeline.

Description: Provision the agreed cloud environments, infrastructure configuration, and supporting services.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm account access, service limits, and approvals; external provisioning waits may need separate elapsed-time tasks.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Cloud infrastructure provisioning.
Provision the agreed cloud environments, infrastructure configuration, and supporting services.
Review results and record acceptance of Cloud infrastructure provisioning.

Description: Design the data structures and relationships needed by the agreed application features.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm data ownership, migration needs, and expected volumes before finalizing the schema.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Database schema design.
Design the data structures and relationships needed by the agreed application features.
Review results and record acceptance of Database schema design.

Description: Implement the agreed authentication and user-account flows.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm sign-in methods, permissions, and account recovery scope; assumptions about these flows can materially change the estimate.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Authentication & user accounts.
Implement the agreed authentication and user-account flows.
Review results and record acceptance of Authentication & user accounts.

Description: Implement the core backend interfaces and business logic required by the agreed features.
Comments: Draft guidance: define endpoint scope and interface contracts early so frontend work can proceed with stable expectations.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Core API endpoints.
Implement the core backend interfaces and business logic required by the agreed features.
Review results and record acceptance of Core API endpoints.

Description: Connect the application to the selected payment and email providers.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm provider access and sandbox availability; distinguish integration effort from vendor onboarding or approval waits.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Third-party integrations (payments & email).
Connect the application to the selected payment and email providers.
Review results and record acceptance of Third-party integrations (payments & email).

Description: Build the frontend structure, navigation, routing, and shared application foundations.
Comments: Draft guidance: use the agreed UI kit and route structure; clarify what belongs in the shell versus individual feature screens.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Frontend app shell & routing.
Build the frontend structure, navigation, routing, and shared application foundations.
Review results and record acceptance of Frontend app shell & routing.

Description: Implement the agreed frontend screens, components, and interaction states.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm the screen inventory and supported devices; split independently deliverable work into tasks if multiple developers will contribute.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Frontend screens & components.
Implement the agreed frontend screens, components, and interaction states.
Review results and record acceptance of Frontend screens & components.

Description: Connect frontend features to backend interfaces and handle the agreed loading, success, and failure states.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm API contract readiness; include integration checks and track interface changes that require rework.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Connect frontend to API.
Connect frontend features to backend interfaces and handle the agreed loading, success, and failure states.
Review results and record acceptance of Connect frontend to API.

Description: Implement the agreed administrative functions and reporting capabilities.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm access controls, report definitions, and data requirements; this resource must represent real available capacity.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Admin & reporting features.
Implement the agreed administrative functions and reporting capabilities.
Review results and record acceptance of Admin & reporting features.

Description: Define the test approach and cases covering the agreed requirements and acceptance expectations.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm test data and environment needs; update coverage when requirements change.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Test plan & test cases.
Define the test approach and cases covering the agreed requirements and acceptance expectations.
Review results and record acceptance of Test plan & test cases.

Description: Implement automated tests for the agreed application flows and integrate them into the delivery workflow.
Comments: Draft guidance: clarify the balance of unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage; include maintenance effort for unstable interfaces.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Automated test suite.
Implement automated tests for the agreed application flows and integrate them into the delivery workflow.
Review results and record acceptance of Automated test suite.

Description: Verify integrated behavior across the application and external interfaces.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm environment and test-data readiness; record defects and distinguish testing effort from subsequent fixes.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Integration & system testing.
Verify integrated behavior across the application and external interfaces.
Review results and record acceptance of Integration & system testing.

Description: Assess the implemented system for the agreed security risks and conduct the planned penetration testing.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm reviewer availability, access, and assessment scope; agree how findings will be prioritized for stabilization.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Security review & penetration test.
Assess the implemented system for the agreed security risks and conduct the planned penetration testing.
Review results and record acceptance of Security review & penetration test.

Description: Measure behavior under agreed workloads and identify performance constraints.
Comments: Draft guidance: agree measurable performance targets and realistic load profiles; distinguish test execution from tuning and fixes.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Performance & load testing.
Measure behavior under agreed workloads and identify performance constraints.
Review results and record acceptance of Performance & load testing.

Description: Resolve prioritized defects and stabilize the application for customer acceptance.
Comments: Draft guidance: replace the Development Team placeholder with actual developer assignments or split fixes into individual-resource tasks; it must not imply extra capacity beyond the named developers.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Bug fixing & stabilization.
Resolve prioritized defects and stabilize the application for customer acceptance.
Review results and record acceptance of Bug fixing & stabilization.

Description: Have customer representatives evaluate the release against the agreed acceptance criteria.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm customer reviewers and acceptance authority; use locked commitments for agreed review dates and separate feedback waits from working effort.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for User acceptance testing.
Have customer representatives evaluate the release against the agreed acceptance criteria.
Review results and record acceptance of User acceptance testing.

Description: Prepare user-facing instructions and help content for the agreed product features.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm the intended audience and publishing format; allow for updates when screens or workflows change.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for User documentation & help content.
Prepare user-facing instructions and help content for the agreed product features.
Review results and record acceptance of User documentation & help content.

Description: Release the accepted application to the production environment and verify the agreed deployment checks.
Comments: Draft guidance: confirm release authority, the cutover window, and rollback arrangements; lock the deployment slot only once it is committed.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Production deployment.
Release the accepted application to the production environment and verify the agreed deployment checks.
Review results and record acceptance of Production deployment.

Description: Monitor the release, respond to launch issues, and support the initial transition into normal operation.
Comments: Draft guidance: clarify whether the estimates represent active support effort or an elapsed monitoring period; reserve staff only for work that actually uses their capacity.
Checklist:
Confirm prerequisites and readiness for Post-launch monitoring & hypercare.
Monitor the release, respond to launch issues, and support the initial transition into normal operation.
Review results and record acceptance of Post-launch monitoring & hypercare.
